This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). ## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

136	### 4.2 families()：必要的第二真相源与 identity-only 边界
137	
138	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
139	
140	检测门的困境（u1-l4 已见过现象，这里讲**为什么无解**）：当用户拿一个 GLM5.2 的 checkpoint 去跑出厂二进制（只编了 qwen3）时，`registry.detect` 只能返回 NoMatch——因为 glm52 的 probe 根本没被编译进二进制，**没有任何代码可以询问**。但用户值得一句「你可能需要 `--features glm52` 重建」的提示。
141	
142	于是 server 硬编码一张身份表 `families()`：feature 名、该线 probe 认领的 `model_type`（含 `text_config.model_type`）身份、以及本二进制是否编译了它。这就是「**必要的**第二真相源」——第一真相源是各模型 crate 自己的 probe，但提示恰恰要服务「第一真相源不在场」的场景，所以这份重复**不可消除**，只能：
143	
144	1. **缩小重复的内容**：表里只存身份字符串，不存结构规则——重复面越小，漂移风险越小；
145	2. **绑定**：用测试把表行与 crate 常量锁在一起（qwen4 行有 `qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate` 绑定测试）；
146	3. **声明能力边界**：文档注释明确提示是 **identity-only**——它不能运行被编译掉的 probe，所以「probe 会拒绝的变体」（量化姊妹版、绑词嵌入、YaRN 绳长外推）也会命中提示。它只报出「该用哪个 feature 重建」，**不承诺重建后这个 checkpoint 能服务**。

156	  └─ NoMatch {..} ───────┐

167	                          ▼

232	### 4.3 LaunchedEngine 迁移边界：共存、删除条件与防漂移
233	
234	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
235	
236	u3-l1 已经画过两代契约的地图；本讲换一个角度——**这块脚手架什么时候拆、拆的时候要带走什么**。
237	
238	`LaunchedEngine` 是迁移期的二选一枚举：`Handle(EngineHandle)` 装 legacy 每 token 契约，`Stepped(Engine)` 装 step 契约交接包。它的文档注释把「删除条件」写进了类型定义：**每条模型线都迁移到 step 驱动后，枚举被删除，只留 `Engine`**。两个为删除而做的设计伏笔：
239	
240	- **两个 `From` 实现**（`From<EngineHandle>` 与 `From<Engine>`）让模型线用 `.into()` 装箱——删除 `Handle` 变体时，step 线的装箱代码不因类型更名而连锁修改；
241	- **server 几乎不打开这个枚举**：`main()` 只搬运它（`spawn_blocking` 的返回类型），唯一的解构点是 LoRA 分支的 let-else。分派逻辑集中在 `vllm/mod.rs` 的 `engine_task` 一处。删除时改动面被类型系统天然限定。
242	
243	**删除的前提**（frontend 架构文档记录的顺序）：先迁 glm52（多调度器试点，带上 P/D 与 EP 的需求），再迁 kimi-k2、deepseek-v2-lite，然后删除 legacy 契约模块与 `LaunchedEngine::Handle`。另有一条硬前提：**`KvPrefix` 前缀解析（`submit_resolved`）目前只存在于 legacy 路径**——要么随迁移在 step 契约上重新安家，要么明确放弃，否则 handle.rs 删不干净。
244	
245	同一个模块里还有一条与「契约演化」相关的纪律：**`ServePlan` 的 `..default()` 展开约定**。契约类型会被不进 CI 的模型 crate 构造，而 CI 只编译三条线（qwen3、qwen35、deepseek-v2-lite），所以在其他 crate 里写**穷尽字面量**构造 `ServePlan`，下一次给契约加字段时那个 crate 无声地坏掉，直到有人手工编译它——约定因此是「用 `..ServePlan::default()` 展开，只拼写你设置的字段」。这是「编译可见性」问题的通用解法，与 `LaunchedEngine` 的删除属于同一主题：**契约演化时，谁受编译器保护、谁不受**。

312	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
313	
314	**练习 1**：两个 `From` 实现对「删除 Handle」有什么实际帮助？没有它们会怎样？
315	
316	**参考答案**：`From<Engine>` 让 step 线可以用 `.into()` 装箱，`launch` 的返回类型从 `LaunchedEngine` 改回 `Engine` 时，这类调用点零修改；`From<EngineHandle>` 在删除时整体移除即可。没有它们，每条线都得手写 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped(engine)`（如 qwen3 现在的 `.map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)`），删除时七处构造点都要同步改写——伏笔把「连锁修改」降为「局部删除」。
317	
318	**练习 2**：为什么 `KvPrefix`（KV 前缀解析）是删除 legacy 契约的硬前提之一？
319	
320	**参考答案**：因为它是**只存在于 legacy 路径的功能**：`KvPrefix` 的 rank 绑定语义与 `submit_resolved` 都长在 handle.rs/kv.rs 上（u3-l6、u5-l1），而 step 契约的调度器目前只能拒绝 `Request` 能表达的东西（含非空 `kv_transfer_params`）。直接删 handle.rs 等于无声地砍掉跨实例前缀复用能力；必须先决定「在 step 契约上重新安家」还是「明确放弃」，否则删除是功能回退而非清理。（依据：[frontend-architecture.md:L57-L59](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../docs/subsystems/frontend/frontend-architecture.md#L57-L59)。）
321	
322	**练习 3**：`ServePlan::default` 展开约定防的是什么漂移？它与「删除 Handle」的共同主题是什么？
323	
324	**参考答案**：防的是**编译可见性**漂移——CI 只编译三条线，未进 CI 的模型 crate 若用穷尽字面量构造 `ServePlan`，契约加字段时它们不会编译失败，坏掉是静默的，直到有人手工编译（依据 [model_line.rs:L286-L292](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L286-L292) 的原文）。共同主题：契约演化时，只有被编译的代码受编译器保护；`..default()` 展开、`From` 预留、扁平 re-export，都是把「演化冲击波」限制在受保护范围内的手段。

331	
332	自查要点（对照 u2-l3 的两本账）：
333	
334	- **单一共享注册消失**：今天 `SharedArgs::augment_args` 在 [ModelLineRegistry::new](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L506-L515) 里以 `ArgOwner::Shared` 注册**恰好一次**。拆散后每个 crate 一份拷贝，`claim_id` 的「`SharedArgs` 与线撞 id」专用 panic（[L439-L451](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L439-L451)，"list it in consumed_shared_args instead"）会在**合法的共享拷贝之间**误触发；要豁免就得给账本开「按设计重复」的口子——唯一性不变式被设计本身削弱。
335	- **值级漂移不可见**：账本只比 id 与拼写，不比值、默认值与 value_parser。今天一份定义，漂移不可能；N 份拷贝后，A 线的 `kv_offload_host_gib` 默认 8.0、B 线 4.0，账本一声不吭。要把检查买回来就得跨 crate 比对值——**变贵**的那部分。
336	- **CORE_ARGS 与 consumed 检查失去靶子**：[CORE_ARGS 断言](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L510-L514) 与 [register_line 的 consumed 断言](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L480-L495) 都对着「共享命令」这本账；拆散后要么删检查（自检失效），要么对 N 份拷贝各查一遍（变贵且仍不查值）。
337	- **consume-or-reject 的分类学退化**：[validate_provided](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L603-L630) 的三分法（核心 / 被消费共享 / 线独占）依赖共享集合存在；拆散后「本线不消费的共享 flag」与「别线的 flag」不可区分，错误消息失去「shared-but-unconsumed」这一类。
338	- **依赖表撞车**：`SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS`（[L223-L232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L223-L232)）与各线 `arg_requirements` 收进同一张 `requirements` 表，[L539-L543](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L539-L543) 的「同一 source 声明两次要求」断言会让两份拷贝的同名边直接 panic——需要先去重，机制又变贵一层。

340	**第 2 问：一个 `model_type=qwen3` 的量化变体在 stock 构建下会得到什么提示？这个提示在什么意义上「过度承诺」？**
341	
342	自查要点（依据 [families() 文档注释](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L54-L66)）：
343	
344	- **直接答案：得不到任何提示，而且不需要提示。** stock 构建 = default = `qwen3` 已编译：提示的先决条件 `!family.compiled`（[L133-L136](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L133-L136)）对 qwen3 恒假；同时 qwen3 的 probe 是 identity-only（[config.rs:L894-L910](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L894-L910)，量化变体的 `model_type`/`architectures` 与 BF16 版相同），所以 detect 直接认领，运行进入引擎加载，量化权重的失败（若发生）以 `failed to start Qwen3 engine` 的 anyhow 链出现。
345	- **「过度承诺」是提示路径的性质，不是这个场景的性质**：对**被编译掉**的家族（如 stock 下的 gemma4/kimi-k2），提示无法运行那个 probe，于是「probe 会拒绝的变体」——量化姊妹版（`quantization_config`）、绑词嵌入、YaRN——也会命中身份、得到 `--features X` 建议（具体反例见 4.2.3 的 gemma4 E4B 与 kimi-k2 尺寸校验）。提示承诺的只是「身份属于该家族、该 feature 值得试」；用户可能读成「重建后一定能跑」。按文档原话："It names the feature to rebuild with; it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable."
346	- 加分项：指出这是一笔**愿打的交易**——宁可给出可能落空的重建建议（成本低、多数场景正确），也不愿让用户面对一段没有方向感的 NoMatch 堆栈。

352	- 前提：glm52 → kimi-k2 → deepseek-v2-lite 依次迁到 step 契约（架构文档记录的顺序）；`KvPrefix`/`submit_resolved` 在 step 契约上安家或明确放弃；legacy watch 通道的 metrics 路径由共享单元 `MetricsPublisher` 全面接管（u4-l6）。
353	- `main.rs` 消失/退化的分支：LoRA 分支的 let-else（[L221-L223](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L221-L223)）退化为普通绑定，`"LoRA serving requires a step-driven engine"` 错误类别消失；**其余 serve 分支零逻辑改动**（分派依据是 `ServePlan` 字段）。
354	- `vllm/mod.rs` 消失的分支：`engine_task` 里 `match launched` 的整个 `Handle` 臂（[L310-L335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L310-L335)）——含 `handle.scheduler_partition_count()` 对账、逐分区 `LocalEngineBridge`、`metrics_watch_for`、`drop(handle)`；`match` 塌缩为 Stepped 臂的直体（计数对账保留，改读 `engine.schedulers.len()`）。
355	- 连带删除：wiring.rs 的枚举与 `From<EngineHandle>`、engine 的五个 legacy 模块及其 re-export、bridge.rs 的 `LocalEngineBridge`。
356	- 加分项：指出「server 侧几乎零改动」本身就是 4.1 纯分发设计的验收——迁移的全部冲击被接缝吸收在 frontend 内部。
357	
358	## 6. 本讲小结
359	
360	- **纯分发**：server 对模型世界的知识 = 一列 `&'static dyn ModelLine`；新增模型线的 server 改动只有注册行 + `families()` 行 + feature。代价是 `families()` 的必要重复、trait 表达力即上限、以及用注册表两本账买回被 `dyn` 放弃的穷尽匹配。
361	- **必要的第二真相源**：提示服务的场景恰恰是「probe 不在场」，所以身份表只能硬编码、不可合并；缓解手段是缩小重复面（identity-only）、绑定测试与定长数组。提示只承诺身份归属，不承诺 checkpoint 可服务——量化/绑词/YaRN 变体会命中一个「probe 本会拒绝」的建议。
362	- **迁移边界**：`LaunchedEngine` 是写明删除条件的脚手架；删除前提是三条 Handle 线全部迁移 + `KvPrefix` 落定；server 侧唯一解构点（LoRA let-else）与装配侧唯一分派点（engine_task 的 Handle 臂）是删除时的全部改动面。
363	- **编译可见性**：CI 只编译三条线，未编译 crate 的契约构造必须用 `..default()` 展开——契约演化的冲击必须限制在受编译器保护的范围内，`From` 预留与扁平 re-export 同属此类伏笔。
364	- **注释是快照**：engine/mod.rs 说「qwen3 已迁移」，现实是四条线已迁移——迁移期的文档注释会滞后，权威状态来自对构造点的 grep 普查。
365	
366	## 7. 下一步学习建议
367	
368	本讲是手册最后一篇，三条继续深入的路线：

# u5-l3 · 设计取舍复盘：纯分发二进制与契约迁移

## 1. 本讲目标

本讲是手册的收官篇，不再引入新的代码路径，而是把前四个单元走过的代码拉远，复盘支撑整个 `pegainfer-server` 的**三个架构决定**：

1. **server 只做纯分发**——一个约 300 行的二进制，不 import 任何模型 crate 的选项类型，新增模型线对 server 代码的改动只是注册表里的一行；
2. **`families()` 作为「必要的第二真相源」**——一份硬编码的身份表，为「被编译掉的模型线」补上检测提示，能力边界是 identity-only；
3. **两代引擎契约共存**——`LaunchedEngine` 枚举是带说明书的迁移脚手架，它写明了自己的删除条件。

学完本讲，你应该能：

- 论证纯分发二进制的收益清单与代价清单（收益不只是「少写代码」，还有编译期裁剪与错误语言的一致性；代价包括 `families()` 的重复与「trait 未表达的事 server 做不了」）；
- 界定 `feature_gate_hint` 的能力边界：它无法运行被编译掉的 probe，量化变体、绑词嵌入（tied embeddings）、YaRN 绳长外推这类「probe 会拒绝的变体」也会命中提示——提示只承诺身份归属，不承诺 checkpoint 可服务；
- 给出两代契约合并的判据：哪些模型线还压在 legacy 一侧、`KvPrefix` 为什么挡住删除、删除后 `main.rs` 与 `vllm/mod.rs` 里哪些分支会消失，以及 `ServePlan::default` 展开约定（CI 只编译三条线）为什么是契约演化的防漂移手段。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲建立在 u2-l3（注册表两本账）、u3-l1（两代契约地图）、u4-l1（serve 装配骨架）之上。在此之上补四个工程决策层面的概念：

- **真相源（source of truth）**：一份信息在仓库里被权威定义的位置。好的设计尽量只有一个真相源；当第二个真相源**不可避免**时（比如 `families()`），好的做法是承认它、写清它为什么必要、再用测试把两份真相**绑定**起来，让漂移（drift，两份拷贝各自演化后不再一致）在提交前被抓住。
- **identity-only（仅身份）**：检测分两层——**身份**（`model_type`、`architectures`，回答「这是哪个家族」）与**结构**（尺寸、量化、滑窗、RoPE 外推，回答「这个 checkpoint 我能不能服务」）。`families()` 表与多数 probe 只看身份；部分 probe（gemma4、kimi-k2）做结构校验。提示只建在身份层。
- **迁移脚手架（scaffolding）**：为平滑迁移而临时存在的结构。`LaunchedEngine` 枚举的文档注释里明确写着它将来会被删除——「会死的设计」也被当作设计的一部分来文档化，这是大型重构里非常值得学习的习惯。
- **编译可见性**：Rust 的 `#[cfg]` 让「代码没被编译」成为一等事实。CI 只编译部分 feature 组合时，**只有被编译的代码受编译器保护**；契约类型的演化（加字段、删变体）对未编译的 crate 是无声的。`ServePlan::default` 展开约定就是针对这一点的纪律。

再回顾三个贯穿本讲的旧结论：注册表构造期对 flag 的 id 与拼写做唯一性 panic（u2-l3）；`LaunchedEngine` 是迁移期 Handle/Stepped 二选一枚举，LoRA 分支只认 `Stepped`（u3-l1）；serve 函数族以「引擎 Future」为参数实现前端与引擎加载并发（u4-l1）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 | 本讲关注点 |
|---|---|---|
| `src/main.rs` | server 二进制：纯分发 | 模块文档、`model_lines()`、`families()`、`feature_gate_hint`、main 的三分支 |
| `Cargo.toml` | server 的依赖与 feature 表 | optional 依赖如何把「模型知识」挡在二进制之外 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs` | 接缝：trait + 注册表 + SharedArgs | 模块文档的「No other server edits」、注册表自检、`ServePlan::default` 约定 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/mod.rs` | 引擎契约的两代分组地图 | 迁移边界的权威注释、扁平 re-export |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/wiring.rs`（辅读） | `LaunchedEngine` 定义地 | 枚举文档的删除条件、两个 `From` 实现 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs`（辅读） | serve 装配骨架 | `engine_task` 对两变体各铸一桥的分派 |
| `../README.md` | 项目门面 | 架构边界表、「两代契约共存」的官方表述 |
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs`（辅读） | qwen3 的 probe | identity-only probe 的实例 |
| `../pegainfer-gemma4/src/probe.rs`、`../pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs`（辅读） | 结构校验型 probe | 「probe 会拒绝的变体」长什么样 |
| `../docs/subsystems/frontend/frontend-architecture.md`（辅读） | 前端架构文档 | 迁移顺序与删除清单的官方记录 |

> 提醒：本讲全部实践都是**源码阅读型与 grep 型**，不触达 CUDA，也不修改源码。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 server 纯分发设计：把「模型的多样性」关进 trait 对象

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

「纯分发（pure dispatch）」指 server 二进制对模型世界的全部知识 = 一列 `&'static dyn ModelLine` trait 对象。它做的事只有四件：**检测模型（detect）→ 校验 CLI（三级 validate）→ 启动引擎（launch）→ 分发服务（serve）**。任何模型特有的 flag、规则、选项类型都住在模型 crate 里，server 从不点名。

这样设计的收益：

- **新增模型线的改动面极小**：注册向量加一行 + `families()` 加一行 + 一个 Cargo feature。`main()` 本体、serve 装配、校验链一行不动。
- **编译期裁剪**：feature 未开启时整个模型 crate 不参与编译。出厂二进制（default = `qwen3`）里**物理上不存在**其他线的代码——这是 `#[cfg]` 给的免费瘦身，不需要任何运行时插件机制。
- **错误语言一致**：`launch` 失败是 `anyhow` 深层上下文链，server 只加一层上下文原样上抛（不分支、不翻译），于是所有模型线的启动错误对用户呈现同一种形态。
- **可测性**：注册表与 CLI 逻辑全部在 frontend crate，用 `StubLine` 就能测（u2-l3）；server 侧只需一个驱动真实二进制的 `detect_gate` 集成测试（u1-l4、u5-l2）。

代价同样真实，且后两个模块分别展开其中两条：

- **`families()` 重复**：被编译掉的线连 probe 都不在二进制里，身份表只能硬编码（→ 4.2）。
- **trait 表达力即 server 能力上限**：server 想在新阶段拿到新事实，就必须先在契约上加方法——`ServePlan` 正是这么长出来的（u2-l5）。
- **放弃穷尽匹配**：用 `dyn` trait 对象而不是枚举，意味着编译器不再强迫你「每加一条线就更新所有分派点」——注册表必须用**自建的两本账**（u2-l3）补回这份检查。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

先看依赖方向（frontend 架构文档的原话是 "thin bin"）：

```text
pegainfer-frontend  ←  pegainfer-core  ←  各模型 crate  ←  pegainfer-server（薄二进制）
     │                                                        │
     │ 定义：ModelLine trait、SharedArgs、LaunchedEngine、        │ 只持有
     │       ModelLineRegistry、serve 函数族                     │ &'static dyn ModelLine
     └──────────────── 契约类型全部由 frontend 拥有 ──────────────┘
```

main() 的装配线（u1-l3 详走过）在本讲视角下重读一遍——注意每一步都只经过 trait 或 frontend 类型：

```text
ModelLineRegistry::new(model_lines())     # 唯一「点名」模型 crate 的地方（cfg 守卫）
  → registry.build_command(...)            # 共享 flag + 各线独占 flag 合并
  → 读 config.json → registry.detect       # 经 probe 认领，拿到 &dyn ModelLine
  → validate_provided / shared.validate / line.validate   # 全部经 trait
  → line.serve_plan(&ctx)                  # 经 trait 拿服务形态
  → spawn_blocking(line.launch(&ctx))      # 经 trait 拿 LaunchedEngine
  → 按 plan 字段选 serve 分支               # 分派依据是 ServePlan，不是模型名！
```

关键观察：**main 的三个 serve 分支（LoRA / prefill-only / 默认）分派的依据是 `plan.lora_modules`、`plan.prefill_only`、`plan.scheduler_partition_count` 这三个「服务形态事实」，而不是「这是 Qwen3 还是 GLM」**。模型身份在 detect 之后就退役了，后续全部用抽象事实驱动——这就是纯分发能保持 300 行的原因。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**证据一：模块文档自我声明。** [src/main.rs:L1-L4](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L1-L4) 开宗明义："pure dispatch over the compiled-in `ModelLine`s. Every model-specific flag, rule, and option type lives in its model crate; this file only wires detection, CLI validation, and the serve path selection together."——这段注释就是本模块的「设计合同」。

**证据二：use 清单里没有任何模型 crate 的类型。** [src/main.rs:L6-L18](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L6-L18) 的全部导入是：`std::time::Instant`、`anyhow`、`clap::FromArgMatches`、`log`、`pegainfer_core::logging`、`pegainfer_frontend::engine::LaunchedEngine`、以及 `pegainfer_frontend::model_line` 下的六个契约项。**唯一出现的「模型知识」是 `SharedArgs`——而它定义在 frontend，不属于任何模型 crate**（这正是综合实践第 1 问的伏笔）。

**证据三：`model_lines()` 是模型 crate 被点名的唯一位置。** [src/main.rs:L24-L43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L24-L43) 每行一个 `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` 守卫的 `&<crate>::model_line::MODEL_LINE`。feature 关掉，这一行连同 crate 一起从编译中消失。配合 [Cargo.toml:L34-L48](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/Cargo.toml#L34-L48) 的 feature 表（每个 feature = 一个 `optional` 依赖，见 [Cargo.toml:L18-L26](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/Cargo.toml#L18-L26)），「注册一行」与「编译一个 crate」被绑成同一个开关。

**证据四：接缝文档承诺「No other server edits」。** [../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:L1-L12](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L1-L12) 写明接缝的设计意图："The server binary holds a feature-gated `ModelLineRegistry` and does pure dispatch — it never names a model crate's option types. Onboarding a model line means implementing `ModelLine` in the model crate and adding the instance to the registry in the server binary. **No other server edits**: argument routing, consume-or-reject validation, and config detection all derive from the trait."——注意这里的成本核算视角：参数路由、consume-or-reject、配置检测这三块逻辑**从 trait 派生**，所以它们永远不需要随模型线增长而修改。

**证据五：serve 分支按 plan 分派。** [src/main.rs:L215-L279](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L215-L279)：LoRA 分支看 `plan.lora_modules`（L215），prefill-only 分支看 `plan.prefill_only`（L254），默认分支把 `plan.scheduler_partition_count` 当 `engine_count` 传给 `serve_with_engine_count`（L267-L277）。三个分支里没有一次 `line.name()` 匹配。另见 [src/main.rs:L188](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L188)：模型名只用于日志横幅。

**证据六：README 的边界表背书。** [../README.md:L173-L181](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../README.md#L173-L181) 给 server 的职责恰好一句话："Detect the model, validate its CLI, and launch the selected engine"；总原则在 [../README.md:L31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../README.md#L31)："Each model owns its scheduler, state, and kernels; serving and KV infrastructure are shared."

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用静态审计亲自验证「纯分发」不是注释口号，而是可 grep 的事实；并量化「新增一条模型线」的真实改动面。

**操作步骤**（在 `pegainfer-server/` 目录下）：

1. 数行数并审导入：`wc -l src/main.rs`；再 `grep -n "^use " src/main.rs`——确认导入清单只含 frontend / core / 标准库与工具 crate。
2. 找模型 crate 的全部出现点：`grep -rn "pegainfer_qwen3\|pegainfer_glm52\|pegainfer_gemma4" src/`——预期**只**命中 `src/main.rs` 的 `model_lines()`（cfg 守卫行）。
3. 对照 [Cargo.toml:L34-L48](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/Cargo.toml#L34-L48) 写出「新增模型线改动面」清单：`Cargo.toml` 两处（optional 依赖 + feature 行）、`src/main.rs` 两处（注册行 + `families()` 行）、模型 crate 一个 `model_line.rs`。据此回答：`main()` 函数本体要改几行？（答案：0。）

**需要观察的现象**：grep 的命中点数量之少（个位数）；`use` 清单里没有任何 `pegainfer_<model>::` 前缀。

**预期结果**：步骤 2 在当前 HEAD 应只命中 `src/main.rs` 第 26-41 行之间的 cfg 守卫行（每条线一行）。若未来 grep 命中了 `model_lines()` 之外的 src 文件，就是纯分发被破坏的信号。

**待本地验证**：`cargo tree -p pegainfer-server --no-default-features` 是否显示零个模型 crate 依赖（需要可编译的环境；逻辑上应当成立，因为模型 crate 全是 optional）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：server 为什么用 `Vec<&'static dyn ModelLine>` 而不是定义一个 `enum Line { Qwen3, Glm52, ... }`？

**参考答案**：三个理由。(1) **类型擦除**：`dyn` 让 server 持有异构列表而不必知道每个变体的负载类型——枚举会把每条线的句柄类型暴露给 server，破坏「不 import 选项类型」。(2) **编译期裁剪**：cfg 守卫的 vec 元素随 feature 增减；枚举的变体集是硬编码的，除非也给每个变体加 cfg，而那会让「未启用变体的 match 臂」问题重新出现。(3) 代价是失去穷尽匹配——注册表因此必须自建两本账做唯一性自检（u2-l3），这是用检查换来的灵活性。

**练习 2**：`main()` 里哪几行代码「同时适用于所有模型线，却又不知道任何模型线的存在」？各举两例。

**参考答案**：分派点本身。例如 [src/main.rs:L185](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L185) 的 `line.validate(&ctx, &provided)?` 与 [src/main.rs:L211](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L211) 的 `line.launch(&ctx)`——通过 trait 对象调用，静态分派到 whichever 线被认领。这就是「分发」的字面含义。

**练习 3**：如果明天要给 server 加一个「启动后打印模型自述文案」的需求，且每条线的文案不同，纯分发架构下正确的做法是什么？

**参考答案**：在 `ModelLine` trait 上加一个带默认实现的 `fn banner(&self) -> String`（或塞进已有的名称/日志路径），由各线覆盖；server 只调用 `line.banner()`。错误做法是在 server 里 match `line.name()`——那会把模型身份重新引进 server，注册一行不再足够，纯分发的改动面承诺破产。（现实中的对照物：`ServePlan` 就是「server 需要新事实 → 契约长出新方法」的实例，见 u2-l5。）

### 4.2 families()：必要的第二真相源与 identity-only 边界

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

检测门的困境（u1-l4 已见过现象，这里讲**为什么无解**）：当用户拿一个 GLM5.2 的 checkpoint 去跑出厂二进制（只编了 qwen3）时，`registry.detect` 只能返回 NoMatch——因为 glm52 的 probe 根本没被编译进二进制，**没有任何代码可以询问**。但用户值得一句「你可能需要 `--features glm52` 重建」的提示。

于是 server 硬编码一张身份表 `families()`：feature 名、该线 probe 认领的 `model_type`（含 `text_config.model_type`）身份、以及本二进制是否编译了它。这就是「**必要的**第二真相源」——第一真相源是各模型 crate 自己的 probe，但提示恰恰要服务「第一真相源不在场」的场景，所以这份重复**不可消除**，只能：

1. **缩小重复的内容**：表里只存身份字符串，不存结构规则——重复面越小，漂移风险越小；
2. **绑定**：用测试把表行与 crate 常量锁在一起（qwen4 行有 `qwen4_hint_identity_matches_the_line_crate` 绑定测试）；
3. **声明能力边界**：文档注释明确提示是 **identity-only**——它不能运行被编译掉的 probe，所以「probe 会拒绝的变体」（量化姊妹版、绑词嵌入、YaRN 绳长外推）也会命中提示。它只报出「该用哪个 feature 重建」，**不承诺重建后这个 checkpoint 能服务**。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

提示的完整决策链（发生在 `main()` 的 detect 错误处理里）：

```text
registry.detect(&config)
  ├─ Ok(line)            → 正常放行，提示逻辑不参与
  ├─ Conflict {..}       → 直接报错（注册表 bug，u2-l3）
  └─ NoMatch {..} ───────┐
                          ▼
              feature_gate_hint(&config)
                model_type        = config["model_type"]        （缺失当 ""）
                text_model_type   = config["text_config"]["model_type"]（缺失当 ""）
                在 families() 里找第一个满足
                    !family.compiled                         ← cfg! 编译期已定
                    && (model_types ∋ model_type || text_model_types ∋ text_model_type)
                的行 → "this looks like a {feature} model;
                         rebuild pegainfer-server with --features {feature}"
                          │
                          ▼
              拼接在 NoMatch 错误消息之后，一次性上抛（不二次尝试）
```

identity-only 边界可以用一张对照表表达——左列是提示**知道**的，右列是（编译后的）probe 才知道的：

| families() 表（提示的知识） | 编译后的 probe（真实裁决） |
|---|---|
| `model_type` 字符串 | `model_type` + `architectures` |
| `text_config.model_type` 字符串 | 结构校验：gemma4 的滑窗/层型/MoE 配置；kimi-k2 的全部维度常量 |
| （不知道） | 量化配置、绑词嵌入、YaRN 等变体特征 |

防漂移的三道闸：`families()` 返回**定长数组** `[Family; 8]`（少写一行要过不了类型检查——加第九条线必须显式改长度）；`compiled` 用 `cfg!` 在编译期求值（表行对本二进制恒真）；qwen4 行的绑定测试 + `detect_gate` 集成测试锁行为（u5-l2）。

The hint is **identity-only**: it cannot run a compiled-out probe, so it also fires for a variant that probe would refuse — a quantized sibling (its `quantization_config`), tied embeddings, a YaRN rope. It names the feature to rebuild with; **it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable**."——综合实践第 2 问要求「依据 families() 的文档注释作答」，答案的全部要点都在这四行里。

- gemma4 的 probe 是 fail-closed 的结构校验：[../pegainfer-gemma4/src/probe.rs:L1-L19](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-gemma4/src/probe.rs#L1-L19) 注释写明 "identity plus the structural facts"；[L64-L75](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-gemma4/src/probe.rs#L64-L75) 会**拒绝** E4B 边缘系列配置（`sliding_window=512` 等）。于是在一个没编 gemma4 的构建里，一个 `model_type=gemma4` 的 E4B config 会得到「rebuild with --features gemma4」——而重建后 probe 照样拒绝它。这就是「过度承诺」的具体形态。

**对照：qwen3 的 probe 是 identity-only。** [../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs:L894-L910](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L894-L910)：只查 `model_type == "qwen3"` 与 `architectures` 含 `Qwen3ForCausalLM`，注释明言 "size and shape validation belong to the config loader"。含义有二：(a) 量化版 Qwen3 的 `model_type`/`architectures` 与 BF16 版完全相同，所以 probe 会**认领**它；(b) 在出厂构建里 qwen3 是编译进来的（`!family.compiled` 为假），提示对它**永远静默**——量化版 checkpoint 的失败发生在后面的引擎加载（错误形态是 `failed to start Qwen3 engine` 的上下文链）。综合实践第 2 问的完整答案必须包含这一层。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`families()` 为什么不能从模型 crate 导入常量，让两份真相合并成一份？

**参考答案**：因为提示的服务对象恰恰是「该 crate 未被编译」的场景。一旦 import 了 crate 的常量，这个依赖就把 crate 拉进编译——出厂二进制就得带上全部八条线，feature 裁剪失效。重复是编译裁剪的直接代价，故称「by necessity」。可行的缓解只剩缩小重复面（只复制身份字符串）+ 绑定测试（qwen4 行）。

**练习 2**：`compiled: cfg!(feature = "glm52")` 为什么必须用 `cfg!` 宏而不是运行时检查？

**参考答案**：`cfg!` 在编译期把表达式替换为布尔字面量，且**不需要**该 feature 对应的代码存在（与 `#[cfg]` 属性同源的求值）；换成任何运行时机制（比如查询已注册线）都会退化成「只能看见编译进来的线」，而提示需要知道的是「哪些线**没**被编译」。表行在本二进制里因此是静态事实，无运行时成本。

**练习 3**：给一个 `families()` 会给出「过度承诺」提示的具体 config，并说明它在哪个意义上过度。

**参考答案**：例：`{"model_type": "kimi_k25", "text_config": {"model_type": "kimi_k2", "hidden_size": 999, ...}}`（尺寸与 kimi-k2 crate 编译常量不符）。在未编 kimi-k2 的构建里，身份命中 → 提示 `--features kimi-k2`；但重建后 [kimi-k2 的 probe](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-kimi-k2/src/config.rs#L43-L79) 会因 `hidden_size` 不匹配拒绝。过度的意义：提示承诺的只是「身份属于这个家族」，用户读到的却是「重建就能跑」——按 [src/main.rs:L66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L66) 的原话，"it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable"。

### 4.3 LaunchedEngine 迁移边界：共存、删除条件与防漂移

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

u3-l1 已经画过两代契约的地图；本讲换一个角度——**这块脚手架什么时候拆、拆的时候要带走什么**。

`LaunchedEngine` 是迁移期的二选一枚举：`Handle(EngineHandle)` 装 legacy 每 token 契约，`Stepped(Engine)` 装 step 契约交接包。它的文档注释把「删除条件」写进了类型定义：**每条模型线都迁移到 step 驱动后，枚举被删除，只留 `Engine`**。两个为删除而做的设计伏笔：

- **两个 `From` 实现**（`From<EngineHandle>` 与 `From<Engine>`）让模型线用 `.into()` 装箱——删除 `Handle` 变体时，step 线的装箱代码不因类型更名而连锁修改；
- **server 几乎不打开这个枚举**：`main()` 只搬运它（`spawn_blocking` 的返回类型），唯一的解构点是 LoRA 分支的 let-else。分派逻辑集中在 `vllm/mod.rs` 的 `engine_task` 一处。删除时改动面被类型系统天然限定。

**删除的前提**（frontend 架构文档记录的顺序）：先迁 glm52（多调度器试点，带上 P/D 与 EP 的需求），再迁 kimi-k2、deepseek-v2-lite，然后删除 legacy 契约模块与 `LaunchedEngine::Handle`。另有一条硬前提：**`KvPrefix` 前缀解析（`submit_resolved`）目前只存在于 legacy 路径**——要么随迁移在 step 契约上重新安家，要么明确放弃，否则 handle.rs 删不干净。

同一个模块里还有一条与「契约演化」相关的纪律：**`ServePlan` 的 `..default()` 展开约定**。契约类型会被不进 CI 的模型 crate 构造，而 CI 只编译三条线（qwen3、qwen35、deepseek-v2-lite），所以在其他 crate 里写**穷尽字面量**构造 `ServePlan`，下一次给契约加字段时那个 crate 无声地坏掉，直到有人手工编译它——约定因此是「用 `..ServePlan::default()` 展开，只拼写你设置的字段」。这是「编译可见性」问题的通用解法，与 `LaunchedEngine` 的删除属于同一主题：**契约演化时，谁受编译器保护、谁不受**。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：两个 `From` 实现对「删除 Handle」有什么实际帮助？没有它们会怎样？

**参考答案**：`From<Engine>` 让 step 线可以用 `.into()` 装箱，`launch` 的返回类型从 `LaunchedEngine` 改回 `Engine` 时，这类调用点零修改；`From<EngineHandle>` 在删除时整体移除即可。没有它们，每条线都得手写 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped(engine)`（如 qwen3 现在的 `.map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)`），删除时七处构造点都要同步改写——伏笔把「连锁修改」降为「局部删除」。

**练习 2**：为什么 `KvPrefix`（KV 前缀解析）是删除 legacy 契约的硬前提之一？

**参考答案**：因为它是**只存在于 legacy 路径的功能**：`KvPrefix` 的 rank 绑定语义与 `submit_resolved` 都长在 handle.rs/kv.rs 上（u3-l6、u5-l1），而 step 契约的调度器目前只能拒绝 `Request` 能表达的东西（含非空 `kv_transfer_params`）。直接删 handle.rs 等于无声地砍掉跨实例前缀复用能力；必须先决定「在 step 契约上重新安家」还是「明确放弃」，否则删除是功能回退而非清理。（依据：[frontend-architecture.md:L57-L59](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../docs/subsystems/frontend/frontend-architecture.md#L57-L59)。）

**练习 3**：`ServePlan::default` 展开约定防的是什么漂移？它与「删除 Handle」的共同主题是什么？

**参考答案**：防的是**编译可见性**漂移——CI 只编译三条线，未进 CI 的模型 crate 若用穷尽字面量构造 `ServePlan`，契约加字段时它们不会编译失败，坏掉是静默的，直到有人手工编译（依据 [model_line.rs:L286-L292](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L286-L292) 的原文）。共同主题：契约演化时，只有被编译的代码受编译器保护；`..default()` 展开、`From` 预留、扁平 re-export，都是把「演化冲击波」限制在受保护范围内的手段。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务**：写一页设计笔记（Markdown，放在你自己的笔记目录，不进仓库），回答三个问题。以下是题目解析与自查要点——先自己写，再对照。

**第 1 问：若把 `SharedArgs` 拆进各模型 crate，注册表的哪些自检会失效或变贵？**

自查要点（对照 u2-l3 的两本账）：

- **单一共享注册消失**：今天 `SharedArgs::augment_args` 在 [ModelLineRegistry::new](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L506-L515) 里以 `ArgOwner::Shared` 注册**恰好一次**。拆散后每个 crate 一份拷贝，`claim_id` 的「`SharedArgs` 与线撞 id」专用 panic（[L439-L451](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L439-L451)，"list it in consumed_shared_args instead"）会在**合法的共享拷贝之间**误触发；要豁免就得给账本开「按设计重复」的口子——唯一性不变式被设计本身削弱。
- **值级漂移不可见**：账本只比 id 与拼写，不比值、默认值与 value_parser。今天一份定义，漂移不可能；N 份拷贝后，A 线的 `kv_offload_host_gib` 默认 8.0、B 线 4.0，账本一声不吭。要把检查买回来就得跨 crate 比对值——**变贵**的那部分。
- **CORE_ARGS 与 consumed 检查失去靶子**：[CORE_ARGS 断言](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L510-L514) 与 [register_line 的 consumed 断言](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L480-L495) 都对着「共享命令」这本账；拆散后要么删检查（自检失效），要么对 N 份拷贝各查一遍（变贵且仍不查值）。
- **consume-or-reject 的分类学退化**：[validate_provided](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L603-L630) 的三分法（核心 / 被消费共享 / 线独占）依赖共享集合存在；拆散后「本线不消费的共享 flag」与「别线的 flag」不可区分，错误消息失去「shared-but-unconsumed」这一类。
- **依赖表撞车**：`SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS`（[L223-L232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L223-L232)）与各线 `arg_requirements` 收进同一张 `requirements` 表，[L539-L543](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L539-L543) 的「同一 source 声明两次要求」断言会让两份拷贝的同名边直接 panic——需要先去重，机制又变贵一层。

**第 2 问：一个 `model_type=qwen3` 的量化变体在 stock 构建下会得到什么提示？这个提示在什么意义上「过度承诺」？**

自查要点（依据 [families() 文档注释](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L54-L66)）：

- **直接答案：得不到任何提示，而且不需要提示。** stock 构建 = default = `qwen3` 已编译：提示的先决条件 `!family.compiled`（[L133-L136](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L133-L136)）对 qwen3 恒假；同时 qwen3 的 probe 是 identity-only（[config.rs:L894-L910](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L894-L910)，量化变体的 `model_type`/`architectures` 与 BF16 版相同），所以 detect 直接认领，运行进入引擎加载，量化权重的失败（若发生）以 `failed to start Qwen3 engine` 的 anyhow 链出现。
- **「过度承诺」是提示路径的性质，不是这个场景的性质**：对**被编译掉**的家族（如 stock 下的 gemma4/kimi-k2），提示无法运行那个 probe，于是「probe 会拒绝的变体」——量化姊妹版（`quantization_config`）、绑词嵌入、YaRN——也会命中身份、得到 `--features X` 建议（具体反例见 4.2.3 的 gemma4 E4B 与 kimi-k2 尺寸校验）。提示承诺的只是「身份属于该家族、该 feature 值得试」；用户可能读成「重建后一定能跑」。按文档原话："It names the feature to rebuild with; it is not a promise that the checkpoint is servable."
- 加分项：指出这是一笔**愿打的交易**——宁可给出可能落空的重建建议（成本低、多数场景正确），也不愿让用户面对一段没有方向感的 NoMatch 堆栈。

**第 3 问：删除 `LaunchedEngine::Handle` 需要哪些前提？当前 `main.rs` 与 `vllm/mod.rs` 里哪些分支会随之消失？**

自查要点（对照 4.3.2/4.3.3）：

- 前提：glm52 → kimi-k2 → deepseek-v2-lite 依次迁到 step 契约（架构文档记录的顺序）；`KvPrefix`/`submit_resolved` 在 step 契约上安家或明确放弃；legacy watch 通道的 metrics 路径由共享单元 `MetricsPublisher` 全面接管（u4-l6）。
- `main.rs` 消失/退化的分支：LoRA 分支的 let-else（[L221-L223](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L221-L223)）退化为普通绑定，`"LoRA serving requires a step-driven engine"` 错误类别消失；**其余 serve 分支零逻辑改动**（分派依据是 `ServePlan` 字段）。
- `vllm/mod.rs` 消失的分支：`engine_task` 里 `match launched` 的整个 `Handle` 臂（[L310-L335](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/a474b264537268022a9c06766f65c90ffd0be6c1/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/mod.rs#L310-L335)）——含 `handle.scheduler_partition_count()` 对账、逐分区 `LocalEngineBridge`、`metrics_watch_for`、`drop(handle)`；`match` 塌缩为 Stepped 臂的直体（计数对账保留，改读 `engine.schedulers.len()`）。
- 连带删除：wiring.rs 的枚举与 `From<EngineHandle>`、engine 的五个 legacy 模块及其 re-export、bridge.rs 的 `LocalEngineBridge`。
- 加分项：指出「server 侧几乎零改动」本身就是 4.1 纯分发设计的验收——迁移的全部冲击被接缝吸收在 frontend 内部。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **纯分发**：server 对模型世界的知识 = 一列 `&'static dyn ModelLine`；新增模型线的 server 改动只有注册行 + `families()` 行 + feature。代价是 `families()` 的必要重复、trait 表达力即上限、以及用注册表两本账买回被 `dyn` 放弃的穷尽匹配。
- **必要的第二真相源**：提示服务的场景恰恰是「probe 不在场」，所以身份表只能硬编码、不可合并；缓解手段是缩小重复面（identity-only）、绑定测试与定长数组。提示只承诺身份归属，不承诺 checkpoint 可服务——量化/绑词/YaRN 变体会命中一个「probe 本会拒绝」的建议。
- **迁移边界**：`LaunchedEngine` 是写明删除条件的脚手架；删除前提是三条 Handle 线全部迁移 + `KvPrefix` 落定；server 侧唯一解构点（LoRA let-else）与装配侧唯一分派点（engine_task 的 Handle 臂）是删除时的全部改动面。
- **编译可见性**：CI 只编译三条线，未编译 crate 的契约构造必须用 `..default()` 展开——契约演化的冲击必须限制在受编译器保护的范围内，`From` 预留与扁平 re-export 同属此类伏笔。
- **注释是快照**：engine/mod.rs 说「qwen3 已迁移」，现实是四条线已迁移——迁移期的文档注释会滞后，权威状态来自对构造点的 grep 普查。

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. - "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
